instruction.text: Which tense is used in the underlined part of the sentence? Assign.

atoms.a: <u>I arrived at the party and rang the doorbell,</u> but I had left the birthday present at home.
I arrived at the party and rang the doorbell, <u>but I had left the birthday present at home</u>

instruction.text: Why is the simple past used here?

atoms.a: <u>I arrived at the party and rang the doorbell,</u> but I had left the birthday present at home.
b: ++The actions happen successively with no emphasis on their completion status.
It emphasises that the act of leaving the present had occurred before the other events started.

instruction.text: Why is the past perfect used here?

atoms.a: I arrived at the party and rang the doorbell, <u>but I had left the birthday present at home.</u>
b: The actions happen successively with no emphasis on their completion status.
